# Security Policy

## Supported versions
| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 0.x (hackathon / pilot) | Yes |

## Reporting a vulnerability
Email the maintainers listed in `docs/08-project/TEAM.md`, with "SECURITY" in the subject line. Please don't open public issues for vulnerabilities. We follow coordinated disclosure.

## Response targets
| Step | Target |
|---|---|
| Acknowledge | 48 h |
| Triage | 5 days |
| Fix critical issues | 7 days |

Incidents covered by the CERT-In Directions (2022) are reported within 6 hours of being noticed. Personal-data breaches follow the DPDP Rules notification steps. Both are described in `docs/05-ops/RUNBOOK.md` (PB-06).

## What we never hold
Aadhaar numbers, VIDs, OTPs, biometrics, face images, government payment data and licence numbers in clear text.

Full detail is in `docs/06-security-compliance/`: SECURITY_ARCHITECTURE, THREAT_MODEL, PRIVACY and STQC_PREAUDIT_PACK.
